description: This Java class is a factory for creating JavaScript message mappers and their configurations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides static methods to generate configuration builders and message mapper instances, primarily for the Rhino JavaScript engine.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating JavaScript message mappers and their configurations within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: createJavaScriptMessageMapperConfigurationBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for JavaScript message mapper configurations, transforming string properties into JsonValue objects.

methods.name: createJavaScriptMessageMapperRhino
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a JavaScript MessageMapper based on the Rhino engine.
